result.title: Vocabulary-Incomplete Unsupervised Vision-Language Model Adaptation
result.summary: In certain real-world scenarios, obtaining labeled data is excessively expensive, motivating increasing interest in adapting models without annotations. Vision-language models (VLMs) provide pseudo-labels for unlabeled images through image-text similarity, enabling adaptation without manual labeling. The previous unsupervised vision-language model adaption methods assume access to an adaptation vocabulary containing all class names. However, a complete vocabulary is difficult to construct in real-world scenarios, as unlabeled data may contain classes that are overlooked or fall outside the current task scope. Thus, we propose Vocabulary-Incomplete Unsupervised Vision-language model Adaptation (VI-UVA), where only a subset of class names are available during adaptation. The vocabulary incompleteness induces an adaptation bias toward provided classes, which degrades omitted-class recognition. To address this issue, we propose Label Space Reconstruction (LSR), which reconstructs a latent label space from the unlabeled data and incorporates it into prompt tuning, thereby extending adaptation beyond the incomplete vocabulary and mitigating the adaptation bias. Furthermore, we derive an omitted-class semantic discrepancy bound for LSR and identify the key factors affecting the bound. Extensive experiments across eight benchmarks demonstrate that LSR outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出词表不完整的无监督 VLM 适配设定（VI-UVA）：适配阶段只能看到部分类名，会带来偏向已给类别的偏差；作者用 Label Space Reconstruction 从无标注数据重建一个 latent 标签空间并注入 prompt tuning，以缓解该偏差、改善遗漏类识别，并给出遗漏类语义差异界与八个基准上的实验。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「用无标注数据重建 latent 标签空间以补偿不完整监督、抑制适配偏差」的思路，可能为 LVR 训练中监督信号不完备、偏差与贡献分配问题提供可核查线索；但论文不涉及推理期 latent 状态的生成与使用，与主线仅有方法层面的间接联系。
